description: Urban Atlas Street Tree Layer (UA_STL) Iceland 2012 is a dataset listed in Icelandic geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.lmi.is. The Urban Atlas provides pan-European comparable land use and land cover data for Functional Urban Areas (FUA). The Street Tree Layer (STL) is a separate layer from the Urban Atlas 2012 LU/LC layer produced within the level 1 urban mask for each FUA. Coverage: IS. Its keywords include STL, Copernicus, Local, Copernicus Land, Urban Atlas, Street Tree Layer. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-is.
